sources.title: ELIZA Emulator (1966 Chatbot) — Talk to ELIZA Online
sources.snippet: Talk to ELIZA online ELIZA is a classic 1966 program that simulates conversation using pattern matching and transformation rules. This modern browser-based ELIZA emulator recreates that style in a clean retro terminal, while the rest of the site explains how it works, why it felt persuasive, and why it still matters in AI history.

sources.title: An Introduction to Character Building for the Eliza AI Agent System
sources.snippet: In this series, I'll be exploring a variety of frameworks and tools for building AI agents, starting with the Eliza framework from AI16z. The Eliza framework allows you to create, customize, and deploy AI-based characters or "personas" that can interact with users online, such as on social media platforms, chat rooms, or forums. sources.title: GitHub - elizaOS/eliza: Open source agentic operating system
sources.snippet: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for autonomous AI agents. This monorepo contains the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. The bootable Linux and Android distributions live in the separate elizaOS/os repository.

sources.title: Eliza Research — AI and people
sources.snippet: Eliza Research builds products at the intersection of AI and people: Eliza, a personal agent and open source operating system, and slop.cash, a swarm contribution platform.

sources.title: The Story Of ELIZA: The AI That Fooled The World
